lesson.meaning: A short written message, a reminder, or an important point you want to remember.
examples: Please take a note of the key decisions made in today's meeting.
I left a quick note on your desk about the new project deadline.
He made a mental note to call the client first thing in the morning.
Could you please send a thank-you note to the guest speaker?
Please note that the office will close early next Friday.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'note' as something you write or remember so you don't forget important things!
